introHtml: Sheaffer business card holders combine the refinement of a legacy writing brand with practical desk or pocket organization. Choose from smooth leather or polished metal finishes that mirror the craftsmanship of Sheaffer pens. Ideal for executive gifts, client appreciation, or sales team kits, these holders keep cards accessible while projecting a polished, professional image. Personalize with your logo or company name using debossing, foil stamping, or screen printing for a lasting impression.
